Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a production-ready transparent BMO sprite strip for Negotchi. ONE ROW OF EXACTLY 8 FRAMES, uniformly spaced across a 2048x688 transparent canvas (eight equal cells of 256x688). In each cell keep ALL artwork within its central 200 pixels, with at least 28px EMPTY horizontal padding to BOTH cell boundaries. The center x positions must be 128,384,640,896,1152,1408,1664,1920. Full body in every cell, no edge clipping or artwork crossing cell boundaries. Character total height about 270px; feet on the same baseline y=540; head around y=295, raised hands may reach y=260. Leave transparent space above and below; no captions, grid, numbers, shadows or props.
Match the original neutral reference BMO exactly: crisp black outline, flat mint-teal rounded rectangular game-console body, light mint face screen, expressive black eyes and mouth, thin flexible teal arms and legs, simple rounded feet. Yellow plus D-pad left, red/magenta large circle lower-right, cyan triangle above-left of red, green small circle above-right of red, dark slot below-screen left, blue small dot below-screen right, two small dark blue pills lower-left. Preserve these asymmetric controls in every pose. Same shallow front-three-quarter view SHOWING THE VIEWER-RIGHT side, with vertical BMO marks and speaker holes. NEVER show the viewer-left side or mirror the character. Consistent scale and anatomy, flat cartoon like references, no texture, no pixel art, no 3D. Each frame is a separately drawn articulated pose, never a transformed static sprite.
Animation to draw: An 8-frame seamless IDLE loop: quiet relaxed standing with arms down and small smile. 1 alert; 2 breathing in with slight elbow relaxation; 3 chest raised subtly and head tilt tiny; 4 eyelids droop; 5 blink closed; 6 eyes reopen; 7 soft exhale relaxed knees; 8 recover to first. Distinct redrawn facial expressions and arm/knee articulation, movement subtle and natural, feet anchored. Not eight identical pictures.
